intent: Create one continuous width-bearing gravel route that follows trusted terrain without centerline chains, cement-like ribbons, or overlap seams.
required_inputs: one authored spline or closed route boundary
responsibilities: sample and feather the route edge
project position and rotation to terrain
merge all visible strata before one final overlap rejection
spawn decorative instances through one orchestrator

output_contract.grounding: project both interior and edge samples to terrain before variation and spawn

hard_failures: multiple independent generators overlapping in one visible route
source mesh silhouette incompatible with the intended gravel identity
promotion_evidence: instance, collision, navigation, coverage, and grounding audit
independent visual scores of at least 4/5 with no hard failure
